mainEntity.name: Where can I source high-quality zinc concentrate in Morocco?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 3 Rocks is a leading supplier of premium zinc concentrate in Morocco. We offer high-quality zinc calamine ore (+37% purity) and zinc concentrate (70% purity) sourced from legendary Moroccan mining regions.

mainEntity.name: What are the key specifications of Moroccan zinc calamine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our zinc calamine ore offers exceptional purity of +37%, a density of 7.14 g/cm³, and a melting point of 419.5°C, making it ideal for galvanization and die-casting.
